## What it is

Number 1, rendered blue. Back-left, on the 135° bolt. Recessed 1. The lowest opening, where the straight entry becomes the helix. Four openings: 20.5, 46.5, 72.5 and 98.5 mm above the deck. The helix starts in the lowest one.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side. The flat face is z = 0. The C is the layer outline, and the widened spine is in that same plane.
- The mouth opens away from the centre. Press the tube in from outside.
- Bore 13.4 mm, wall 1.6 mm, mouth 11.5 mm. The spine is 8 mm thick, 4 mm wide at the bores and 11 mm wide between them.
- The bottom end is a 4 × 8 mm tab, 4 mm long, into a 4.2 × 8.2 mm slot. A straight notch at the top takes the disc. The recessed 1 is on the spine.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up. That puts the layer lines across the snap.
- Don't leave anything proud of the outer face. The tube has to press straight into the mouth.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: openings cut into the bar. The neck is gone. The foot still fits the old slot.
